description: Read the current user's auto-sell configuration (`autoSettings`). Returns the full `autoSettings` object — call this before `tronsave_register_auto_sell` or `tronsave_update_auto_sell_setting` to avoid overwriting fields you do not intend to change. Requires a signature session and `mcp-session-id`. Read-only and idempotent.
name: tronsave_get_user_auto_setting
